notes.title: Announcing the first DLC expansion and update that will be released with it!
notes.content:
[h1]Everyone please welcome the Slime Queen![/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1632380/Helga_Euphoriums_Song__Lewd_Slime/

[previewyoutube=WOcXSWGYjuE;full][/previewyoutube]

Slime Queen is going to be in the first DLC of the game.  She needs the help of Helga and her friends with a problem in return of sexual favors and other good stuffs.

[h2]Feature list for DLC[/h2]

[list][*]3 new sexual pictures
[*]One new short dungeon
[*]One new ending
[*]Unique permanent buff, if you help the queen!
[*]Two new achievements
[*]Random flavor text[/list]

The new DLC is recommended to be played on low levels but even late game power houses will enjoy the unique ending, buff and the sexual pictures!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1632380/Helga_Euphoriums_Song__Lewd_Slime/

[b]Launch of the DLC will be in June 19th![/b]

[h3]We're also working on a huge 2.0 update![/h3]

The 2.0 update will contain various QoL improvements and optimizations but most of all, it'll bring the most requested feature from our players; gallery! You will be able to see all the pictures you've unlocked across any saves using the gallery function!
